scenarios.name: The /tools panel lists the tool groups
scenarios.description: User opens the /tools panel to review the tool permission configuration; the panel lists the builtin tool groups (read, shell, web, write) with a filter — the tool-trust management surface
scenarios.observe: The /tools slash command opens the tools panel listing the builtin tool groups (read, shell, web, write) with a search filter and an esc-to-close hint.
